name: Fuuki Iin Shirosa
source:
A delinquent at school was found smoking and was suspended.

Having discovered him smoking the other day, Shirosa was determined to have told on the teachers, and was gang-raped as revenge.

Starting with the gang-rape, Shirosa's life was transformed into a sex life, and her daily life was hopelessly stained with shame.

As she was subjected to the delinquents' orders and spent her days being violated, Shirosa told herself to endure the present and return to her previous life.

But what will the outcome be for her?
